messages:
alex: Heads up — saw a surprising p99 jump on the eu embeddings endpoint right after the morning route weight rebalance. p50/p95 look fine. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/graphs?panel=eu-embed :eyes:
maria: I saw that too. p99 roughly doubled for a 30m window. wonder if the sample source changed when we moved weight. :confused:
tj: Can you paste the raw query you used for the panel? I can run some raw traces to compare.
alex: panel query (rough):
```
# console metric query
metric: latency_tokens_ms{endpoint="eu-embed"}.quantile(0.99, window=1m, rollup_mode=weighted-rollup)
group_by: [route, region]
```
deploy-bot: Canary weight update: route=eu-embed moved fallback-pool weight 40% -> 70% at 2025-06-10T09:12:03Z (change-id: canary-20250610-0912)
sre-jen: We didn't change model or quantization this morning, so telemetry/aggregation change is likelier.
sam: Hypothesis: when we rebalanced weights the sample origin switched (gateway-side vs client-side). Dashboard percentiles are computed from rollup buckets that assume preserved sample weighting. If the sample origin or sampling rate changed, weighted-rollup can produce a different p99 than raw.
maria: Console has two aggregation modes: "sampled" (store raw samples) and "weighted-rollup" (merge counters/tdigest with weights). Which one backs that panel?
alex: I believe that panel was switched to weighted-rollup during the dashboard refactor last month.
tj: If the panel uses weighted-rollup and the route weight moved, the rollup weights used in the dashboard could be stale or misapplied -> p99 flips. We should surface sample_origin and rollup_mode in the panel legend.
maria: Quick check request: can someone run the raw metric (no rollup) for the last hour and compare p99? endpoint=eu-embed quantile=0.99
alex: running raw now (no rollup): raw_p99 ≈ 110ms over last hour; dashboard shows ~220ms at the spike time.
tj: So the rollup doubled it. This matches a weighting mismatch. Open an issue to add a 'rollup_mode' badge and 'sample_origin' tooltip to the dashboard legend and also to validate rollup weights after a routing change.
maria: :+1: For mitigation, should we revert the weight change? That would impact capacity/balancing for other tenants.
sam: Ops: we can pin eu-embed to dedicated pool at 60% for 10mins to absorb traffic without full revert. We have capacity headroom ~30% for 15m.
sre-jen: I can flip the pin if we decide. But prefer a dashboard fix first so we understand the signal.
alex: I'll open a quick PR to show sample_origin + rollup_mode on panels and add a small detection toast when route weights change that invalidates rollup caching. Assigning to @tj and @maria. I'll also link the raw query and the graph.
tj: Also add a unit/integration test that runs a synthetic dataset where we change route weights and assert percentile invariance when modes are correct (and that a warning triggers when weights change).
deploy-bot: No automatic rollback scheduled for canary-20250610-0912.
alex: Plan: 1) dashboard badge + toast (quick PR) 2) synthetic test + merge 3) if p99 still mismatches, revert or pin route. Proceeding with 1 now.
maria: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/1234 — add rollup_mode & sample_origin visibility + weight-change detection.
tj: Assigning to eng-platform + devex. ETA EOD?
alex: ETA EOD. will post updates and link PR here.
sam: FYI I added a log entry to /var/log/route_rebalance.log for the 09:12 event with the full diff.
alex: thanks — will use that to cross-check weight timestamps. ping me once exploit log is up.
sre-jen: ping in 20m to see if we need to pin.
alex: PR merged (quick UI patch) and deployed to staging. panels now show "rollup_mode=weighted-rollup" and "sample_origin=gateway" badge on the eu-embed graph.
maria: can you re-check p99 vs raw after that?
alex: re-checking: after patch p99 on dashboard aligns with raw ~110ms. the spike value (220ms) no longer present. looks like stale rollup weights were the culprit.
tj: great. follow-up: add an automated invalidation when route weights change, plus a small note in rollout playbook.
maria: leaving this thread open until we add the invalidation check.
alex: closing once invalidation test lands. I'll post the PR link.
alex: follow-up: invalidation test + toast landed in console main, issue #1234 updated and closing in next release. "Resolved" by UI visibility + rollup invalidation.
